seeds.user_note: Content that attracts business clients — want related traffic on CRS.
seeds.what_the_page_is: Ontario's Tax Compliance Verification (TCV) service. A business must be tax compliant to be eligible for certain Ontario government licences, programs, contracts and agreements. Free; run through an ontario.ca login; corporate income tax and GST/HST filers must upload a current original PDF Filing and Balance Confirmation (FBC) letter from CRA (obtained via CRA My Business Account); the business receives a TCV number and can download a certificate. ServiceOntario 1-866-668-8297.
seeds.crs_angle: CRS does not do tax. The commercial bridge is that a business chasing an Ontario government contract is usually asked for TWO different proofs and confuses them: the TCV number (tax standing, Ontario Ministry of Finance) and a Certificate of Status / corporate profile report (registry standing, Ontario Business Registry). CRS supplies the second one. Article explains the difference, when each is demanded, and links to /good-standing and /guides/corporate-profile-report-vs-certificate-of-good-standing.
seeds.resolution: Do NOT write a standalone page — it would compete with existing queue item 7 (certificate-of-status-ontario) and with /guides/what-is-a-certificate-of-good-standing-canada. Instead the TCV-vs-registry distinction becomes the opening section and an FAQ pair inside certificate-of-status-ontario when that item is written. Queue row 7 updated with this instruction.
seeds.duplicate_check: /good-standing, /guides/what-is-a-certificate-of-good-standing-canada, /guides/corporate-profile-report-vs-certificate-of-good-standing all exist; queue item 7 already targets 'certificate of status ontario'.
seeds.editorial_caution: Never restate Ontario's TCV process as if CRS performs it, and never imply CRS can obtain a TCV number or an FBC letter. Describe TCV factually, cite ontario.ca, and keep the CRS offer to registry documents.
